subject_definitions: <Picture 1> is the uploaded 身份 reference at order 1. <Subject 1> is Sue in <Picture 1>, with a young woman with warm brown pinned-up hair and a faded blue-green high-collar blouse. <Picture 2> is the accepted opening frame for [Shot 1], fixing the approved starting composition, visible positions, and initial state for this shot.
summary: [keyframe completion + reference generation] The target video is a single vertical period-drama shot in the early-1900s New York artist-apartment world. Sue listens in the doorway as the doctor's judgment remains an off-screen pressure. The opening is anchored by <Picture 2> and preserves <Subject 1>.
retention_analysis: <Picture 1> (reference image order 1): fully_preserved - its 身份 role is retained as the input reference for this shot. <Picture 2> (opening frame of [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - the supplied starting composition, visible placement, and initial state open the shot. <Subject 1> (appears in [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - a young woman with warm brown pinned-up hair and a faded blue-green high-collar blouse remain stable; the approved motion changes only the shot's stated action and endpoint.
detailed_description: The target video is a realistic live-action period drama in a vertical 9:16 frame, with restrained natural light, tactile period materials, and observational camera movement. The shot begins from <Picture 2>. <Subject 1> stands at the half-open door, with the bed and window visible through the opening. The doctor remains off-screen throughout. At 0.00 to 2.80 seconds the doctor (S3) speaks in a low measured off-screen voice: <d>[Chinese] 她的身体还有机会。真正危险的是，她已经替自己决定了结局。</d> Sue listens with one hand on the doorframe. From 2.80 to 4.70 seconds her eyes travel through the gap to Johnsy's bed, then return toward the depth of the corridor. From 4.70 to 6.50 seconds the doctor continues off-screen: <d>[Chinese] 那就让她重新想起一件明天还要做的事。</d> At 6.50 to 7.00 seconds the doctor falls silent and a cough comes from inside the room. Keep the corridor visibly empty and use a very slow push toward the doorway; one continuous take with no cut. No non-diegetic subtitles, captions, or dialogue text overlays appear at any moment. Continuity locks: faded blue-green high-collar blouse; narrow top-floor artist studio with a tall rain-streaked window and exposed brick.
overall_soundscape: Old-apartment corridor hush, low rain at the window, the door's faint wood creak, Johnsy's cough at the ending, and the doctor's voice kept outside the frame.
non_diegetic_music: N/A
